mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the channels was most worthwhile because it explained how a message travels through local electrical changes without one ion travelling the whole length.

leastWorthwhile.text: Developing the two cell types felt somewhat repetitive: both used named messengers with the population, though their pictures showed different outcomes.

surprise.text: I was surprised that other cells wrap their membranes around stretches of one continuous nerve-cell extension, with gaps between the wraps.

arbitrary.text: The messenger pairings were clear from their names and pictures, but I followed those hints without understanding exactly how the messengers cause cells to develop differently.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the explanation of the moving message and the picture of the separate insulating cells made me curious about what nerve cells do next, even though the pairings were fairly straightforward.
